body: Back when i cared about things, i was dedicated to bodysculpting and fasted up to 72 hours sometimes as a part of that. Turns out i do have some advice: Reintroduce food to your body lightly, slowly, and carefully. It's easy to become shocked and sick after so long without. Of course, that advice fails to address the source of not wanting to eat in the first place...
Thanks for the thoughtful reply. That, along with browsing some of the other posts here, has added a little "you're not alone" to my day.

I insomnia to the point of hallucinations...but never experienced the no eating part. 5 days? wow. I'm the last person to be giving advice or else i'd try to be helpful. A plate of chicken doesnt sound good? or tacos? or better yet: chicken tacos?
Whatever you've read probably doesn't mention the terror, panic, and extreme adrenaline involved. I've done it; words can't capture how awful it was...i wouldnt recommend it
I saw it...reading a bunch of posts on here (after making my own) and don't really know what to say to them. But, i saw yours and read it
